phases.objective: Expose an authenticated information_schema-only census that inventories all runtime tables and proposes fail-closed sanitized-clone classifications without reading application row values or performing mutations.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized Production administrator performing sanitized-clone discovery
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The response contains schema metadata, estimated row counts, relationships, and preliminary fail-closed classifications with explicit zero-mutation and zero-row-value-read evidence.
steps: Authenticate through the existing backend-key and admin-principal guards.
Read table, column and foreign-key metadata only from information_schema.
Classify secret, identity, operational, PII-bearing, reference and unknown surfaces using metadata names and types.
Return all classifications with copy authorization still required.
assertions: Only information_schema.TABLES, information_schema.COLUMNS and information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE are queried.
No application table SELECT, exact COUNT, row-value scan, database mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, Production mutation, Staging mutation or secret exposure occurs.
Unknown and opaque surfaces fail closed to manual_review.
The pre-existing default census response remains unchanged when scope is omitted.
Every reported row count is explicitly labelled estimated and sourced from information_schema.TABLES.TABLE_ROWS.

phases.objective: Capture a separately authorized live Production metadata census and review candidate classifications.
Validate bounded behavior for information_schema permission and availability failures.
Exercise the read-only scope against Staging before Production rollout.
Deploy only after exact-head authorization and capture read-only Production evidence.
